name: Baza (Spain)
description: Square red flag charged at the centre with the arms of the city of Baza (a walled city with towers on red beneath a crown with mantling).
history: Baza adopted its flag officially on 24 March 2017 and its arms on 17 January 2018; the flag is red in memory of the Nasrid standard and the royal standard of Castile, charged with the arms of the city, a version of those granted by the Catholic Monarchs on 28 August 1494, which preside over the old Casa de Cabildos.
